cycle.description: 甲 is Yang Wood (阳木), conventionally associated with initiative, growth and outward development. 子 corresponds to Rat and its conventional branch element Water. Together, 甲子 identifies one position in the sixty-part 干支 cycle. The stem quality and branch association are separate layers; their combination is not a guaranteed outcome.

乙 is Yin Wood (阴木), conventionally associated with adaptation, cultivation and gradual growth. 丑 corresponds to Ox and its conventional branch element Earth. Together, 乙丑 identifies one position in the sixty-part 干支 cycle. The stem quality and branch association are separate layers; their combination is not a guaranteed outcome.
